mentions.name: Swolog
mentions.description: A local-first workout tracking app built around text: it functions as an advanced editor/viewer for one long text note, with an optional self-hosted backup server.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Updating my workout app with final touches. It’s local first, with self-hosted backup server as an option.

It’s text based, so it is basically an advanced editor/viewer for one long text note.
